ci.auditFix.untested: '{command}' resolves advisories and is untested — run it locally and commit.

coverage.heading: Coverage
coverage.diff.heading: Changed lines
coverage.diff.noReport: No line-level report (lcov, Cobertura, Go cover, coverage-final.json) — diff coverage skipped.
coverage.annot.diffNeedsLines: diff coverage needs a line-level report
guard.check.passedSummary: Directional board guard passed — no external drift on this commit.
guard.check.failedSummary: External board drift detected. Run `npm run cards:reverse`, commit, and push.
guard.drift.prChanges: The {board} has external changes not reflected in this PR branch.
guard.drift.prAllowed: (Forward-pending card edits in this PR are allowed — only board moves block merge.)
guard.drift.prBlocked: Merge is blocked until you pull board state into this branch:
guard.drift.postDiffers: After forward sync, the {board} still differs from committed cards.
guard.drift.postCause: This may indicate a partial sync, API lag, or concurrent board edits.
guard.drift.mainChanges: The {board} has external changes not in this commit.
guard.drift.mainAllowed: (Intentional card edits waiting for forward sync are allowed.)
guard.drift.mainRun: If the board moved independently, run locally:
guard.drift.external: External drift (board changed, branch did not):
guard.drift.changed: Changed card files after reverse pull:
cards.fail.project: The CI cannot find the board for this repository, so it cannot pull it before pushing cards. Details: {message}
cards.fail.config: The sync backend is missing settings. Locally, set them in .env; in CI, add them as repository secrets or variables and pass them to the step (npm run cards:doctor checks them). Details: {message}
cards.fail.validate: Fix the card files flagged above (frontmatter and hierarchy), then push again. Reproduce locally: npm run cards:validate
cards.fail.reverse: Could not read the board into .github/cards/. The API error is in the log above; 401/403 usually means the sync token is missing, expired or has no access to the board. Reproduce locally: npm run cards:reverse -- --dry-run
cards.fail.forward: Could not write the cards to the board. The API error is in the log above; 401/403 usually means the sync token is missing, expired or has no write access. Reproduce locally: npm run cards:sync -- --dry-run
cards.fail.drift: The board has edits that are not in .github/cards/ on this branch. Run npm run cards:reverse, commit .github/cards/ and push. The affected cards are listed in the log above.
cards.fail.postVerify: After pushing the cards and retrying once, the board still differs from .github/cards/ (partial sync, API lag, or someone editing the board at the same time). Re-run the job; if it keeps failing, run npm run cards:reverse locally and review the diff.
cards.fail.items: {count} card(s) failed to create/update on the board: {ids}. The API error for each one is in the log above.
cards.fail.token: {script} needs GITHUB_TOKEN to publish its check. Give the job `env: GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}` and `permissions: checks: write`.
cards.fail.headSha: {script} needs the SHA of the PR head commit to attach its check. Pass --head-sha <sha> (the recheck workflow passes the matrix head_sha) or set CARDS_PR_HEAD_SHA on the step.
cards.fail.notify: All {count} notification(s) failed. Check the webhook URL secrets; each error is in the log above.
cards.fail.unexpected: {script} stopped with: {error}. This is usually the board API, the network or authentication: check that the sync token is set and not expired, that it has the permissions the board needs, and that the API is reachable from the runner. Re-run with --verbose for the full stack trace; if none of these explains it, open an issue in the Hyperion repository with the log.
reconcile.duplicate.line2: The canonical issue is #{keep}. Hyperion sync ignores this copy — edit the canonical one and close this when convenient.
reconcile.report.title: Last card reconcile
reconcile.report.deletedLocally: Deleted locally (issue kept open/closed, card not recreated)
reconcile.report.closedNoCard: Closed issues without a local card (not recreated)
reconcile.fallbackPrBody: Automatic card reconcile could not push to {branch} (protected or diverged). Review and merge.
sync.footer.title: Hyperion sync

lang.missing: locale not set in project.yml — falling back to en. Run /setup (it asks the team language) or add `locale: <tag>`.
lang.noCatalog: No message catalog for {tag} — CI/CLI messages fall back to English. Add .github/i18n/{tag}.json (keys from scripts/hyperion/i18n/en.json) to translate them.
lang.partial: {tag}: {count} message(s) missing in .github/i18n/{tag}.json — those fall back to English.
